title: JustWatch, which tackles streaming fragmentation, launches own streaming service
gist: JustWatch, the streaming guide with 50 million customers, launched its own ad-supported and $4/month streaming service, JustWatch TV, mainly to deepen audience data for its film-marketing ad business. The library is a few hundred dated titles, and the company targets 100 million monthly users.

insights.claim: JustWatch launched JustWatch TV, an ad-supported free tier plus a $4/month ad-free subscription and a $50 limited-time lifetime plan, with a library of only a few hundred titles from about 30 content partners.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: A guide business moving into content signals that discovery layers see value in owning the viewing relationship, but a thin catalog limits near-term scale.

insights.claim: The service is framed as a data play: JustWatch TV is meant to feed first-party viewing data into JustWatch Media, which sells film-marketing campaigns across YouTube, Meta and TikTok to studios, distributors and streamers.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: The streaming product is likely a loss-leader for an ad-targeting moat; the real revenue line is campaign planning and buying.
insights.quote: “[JustWatchTV] will provide even deeper audience data and insights for JustWatch Media
insights.locator: Streaming service aims to drive ad business

insights.claim: JustWatch targets 100 million monthly users for the streaming service 'in the years to come', versus a guide audience it puts at 50 million customers.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: The goal implies doubling reach through a service that today has no stated user count, so it should be treated as aspirational.

insights.claim: Roku-owned Howdy, a $3/month ad-free service with a similarly limited library, reportedly reached 1 million subscribers six months after launch, which offers a benchmark for cheap niche streamers.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Low-price, thin-catalog tiers can find an audience, which supports the viability of JustWatch's pricing but at modest scale.

insights.claim: The free tier includes films not free on any other service and plays without an account, lowering friction versus subscription rivals.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Frictionless ad-supported access is the lever for data capture, since the service can profile viewers without sign-up cost.
